chunks: The silver coins showed forth their faces! Certainly, this house speaks of your riches.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'silver coins showed forth their faces' mean in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This aphorism from Nahj al-Balagha highlights the concept of 'Zuhd' (asceticism) versus visible wealth, reflecting the socio-political context of the Umayyad era where governors often displayed opulence to assert authority. It serves as a critique of materialism, suggesting that true status is not merely architectural but moral, a key theme in Shia ethical discourse on leadership and humility.
